pages.text: You have always wanted the power to truly "lift" blocks. After watching a Mutant Enderman, you folded the power of the enderman's hand into this focus. Cast while sneaking to teleport to the block your cursor points at; right-click to lift a block and throw it - bedrock, of course, is out of the question.
Cast from a $(l:crafts/staff/void_staff)Void Staff$() and the block you throw carries a Void Blight with it.
